verdict.rationale: Skills can bundle scripts (e.g., the PDF skill merges multiple PDFs, and skills can include arbitrary executable scripts) which could technically enable processing multiple items, but there is no documented feature or example specifically about performing bulk operations across many items at once (e.g., batch processing large sets of files or records). missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation examples/documentation, evidence of scaling to 'many' items, and independent confirmation that skills reliably execute multi-item batch workflows.
